title: IdotPack
description: This pack is meant to make your experience unique and more exciting with friends by adding many new fun ways to play the game!
body:
# IdotPack
This pack adds many mods meant to make your experience unique and more fun with friends!

### Features:
- More interesting terrain generation with new biomes and structures
- Origins for personalized experiences
- New technology with Create
- New mobs that roam the world
- New weapons such as longswords, scythes, chakrams and more
- Useful items such as waystones and backpacks
- Quality of life mods
- And so much more!

This mod was made for me and my friends to use, but anyone is allowed to use it if they wish!
